cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Specialist position at IKEA. Your focus on maximizing organic traffic through strategic SEO and link building resonates with my experience in driving search visibility for client websites and personal projects.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client sites, from keyword research to publishing, and track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. I write keyword-targeted blog content and build WordPress sites, ensuring content is optimized for both users and search engines. This role has honed my ability to collaborate with content and marketing teams to keep content fresh and aligned with SEO goals.

On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I also ran iterative technical SEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This hands-on work has given me a deep understanding of metadata sculpting, sitemap structuring, and the importance of mobile strategy in SEO.

I am driven by continuous learning and experimentation, and I thrive in fast-paced environments. I am eager to contribute to IKEA's mission to become the world's leading multichannel home furnishing retailer. My background in front-end development and web design provides a technical foundation that helps me implement SEO changes effectively.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills in SEO, SEM, and content strategy can support IKEA's digital growth.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
